description: This file defines a SwiftUI wrapper around WKWebView with coordinator pattern for managing web content, navigation, and interactivity within an iOS app. It includes classes for web view setup, controller coordination, navigation delegate, and message handling for deep links and UI actions.

classes.name: ScreenWebView
classes.description: A SwiftUI UIViewRepresentable that manages and displays a WKWebView, coordinating with a ScreenController for updates.

classes.name: ScreenWebViewCoordinator
classes.description: Coordinator class responsible for managing WKWebView lifecycle, configuration, and communication with ScreenController.

classes.name: ScreenNavigationDelegate
classes.description: WKNavigationDelegate implementation to handle navigation events, particularly intercepting custom URL schemes like 'openclaw://'.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler
classes.description: WKScriptMessageHandler implementation handling messages from web content for UI actions.

methods.name: makeContainerView
methods.description: Creates and configures the WKWebView and its container view, attaching it to the view hierarchy.

methods.name: updateController
methods.description: Updates the controller reference and manages WebView attachment/detachment.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Cleans up references and handlers for deinitialization.

methods.name: makeWebView
methods.description: Creates a configured WKWebView instance with custom settings.

methods.name: installA2UIHandlers
methods.description: Registers message handlers for web-to-native communication.
